name: Statistics Canada Web Data Service
tagline: Open JSON/XML access to Canadian official statistics and data tables
description: Statistics Canada's Web Data Service (WDS) provides free programmatic access to official Canadian socioeconomic, demographic, and statistical data tables. Developers can query cube metadata, series, and observations via REST endpoints without an API key, enabling open-data applications, research tooling, and automated statistical retrieval.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public REST endpoints; no API key or OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free open data; no usage fees published

example.response_snippet: [{"status":"SUCCESS","object":{"productId":17100005,"cansimId":"17-10-0005","cubeTitleEn":"Population estimates on July 1st, by age and sex","frequencyCode":9,"nbSeriesCube":...}}]

use_cases: fetch metadata for a Statistics Canada data cube by product ID
retrieve latest statistical observations for a Canadian economic series
list available coordinates and dimensions for a data table
download time-series values for population or labour force indicators
